description: The utility SHALL enumerate all filesystem objects within the configured target directories to produce an inventory. The utility SHALL accept a test directory as input. The utility SHALL enumerate only regular files within the provided directory, without altering any of them. For each enumerated file, the utility SHALL compute the SHA-256 hash. The utility SHALL record the file path and file size of each file in a local JSON report. The utility SHALL present a final summary after processing completes.
name: filesystem_processing_and_reporting
